entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 700 metres Friday morning, and to 400 metres by Friday evening. Expect 1 to 3 cm to accumulate above 700 metres and lesser amounts to 400 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Occasional rain is expected and the snow level lowers to around 800 metres during Friday morning and 3 to 5 cm of snow may accumulate near the summit. Snow levels lower further during Saturday morning down to about 300 metres and 1 to 2 cm of snow could accumulate down to this level.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to developing above 800 metres during Friday morning. Initially little, if any, snow is likely to accumulate on the road. The snow level should lower to 500 metres around Friday evening and from Friday evening to Saturday morning, 1 to 3 cm of snow may accumulate at the summit with lesser amounts down to 500 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 900 metres late tonight, then gradually lower to 400 metres during Friday. Expect 4 to 8 cm to accumulate about Homer Tunnel and lesser amounts to 400 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected above 800 metres during Friday morning, although only 1 cm or less should accumulate on the road above 800 metres. Further snow above 600 metres is likely from late Friday afternoon until Saturday morning and 2 to 5 cm may accumulate near the summit with lesser amounts down to 600 metres.
